observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan (3498 x 1870) lightly blurred, in nine tiles at full size with a 0.02 grid and closer crops (the hatch's rim, the header in four strips, the centre post, the left pillar, the dash in three strips, the top right), against a reference render of the cabin from about the right place (not the photo's camera: the view has no camera yet), SM_CabFittings' builder and the cabin data
covers: the cab's front from behind the front seats: the roof's central opening and its coaming, the roof round it (the olive junction box, the white holders, the signal flags, their white tubes and the bag), the type plate, the header with its loom, the visors and the blue lamp, both windscreens with the centre post and the wipers outside, the left pillar (junction box, plates, ring bracket), the gauge and its pipe at the right, the sill, the steering wheel and the dash's panels along the bottom
notes: Image left is the driver's side. Looking up and forward, higher in the image is the roof nearer the camera: the opening lies in the roof between the camera and the header, and the flags run fore and aft on the roof at the right. The model has here: one glass mesh with plain rounded frames in a flat grey front wall, a flat near-black roof with no opening, SM_CabFittings (two flat visor slabs tilted up 25 degrees on dark lugs, three thin black cables sagging between six steel clip blocks, a raised seam strip, a black cable and a latch with a ring on the centre post, two thin cables with tabs down the left pillar, a wiper motor can on the dash top at the left and two wiper spindle posts at the panes' lower edges), the steering wheel, and the dash as the driver's and commander's panels (black gauges, a 2 x 12 matrix of dark windows, the DP-3B as a grey bezel with a gauge and a knob). The cab's dome lamp (dome_cab) is in the roof's centre about 1.2 m aft of the screens. Sizes are given against the type plate, the visors, the gauges and the steering wheel (0.5 m in the model).

details.what: the roof's central opening: a rounded rectangle across the cab's centre line, straight along the header side, its two corners of large radius turning up into straight sides that run back over the camera
details.size_cue: about five type plates wide at the header side; corner radius about two-thirds of the type plate's length
details.note: one opening on the centre line, not the driver's or commander's hatch to one side

details.what: the coaming's section along the header side: a deep flange dropping from the rim (a light face), a darker underside facing down, a rolled bead at its foot and a dark shadow line where it meets the roof's front band: a box-section lip, not a plain cut
details.size_cue: rim to shadow about four times the type plate's height

details.what: the rolled bead along the coaming's lower edge: a bright round highlight the opening's whole width, rust-stained beneath it
details.size_cue: about a third of the type plate's height thick

details.what: a groove along the coaming's face just under the rim, rust in it

the coaming's left side: two sloping bands (the side wall and its flange) running up and back from the opening's left corner into the roof over the camera, an orange strap in the dark gap at their foot (d23)
the coaming's right side: the corner's large radius and two parallel bands (side wall and flange) running up and to the right toward the flags
rust along the rim's edge, in the groove and under the bead; the paint flaking white in a long streak on the right flange; grime on the underside
a white rounded rod seen through the opening at its left (the lid's handle or stay)
two thin parallel rods hanging in the opening from above down to the rim (a torsion bar, a stay or a lead)
dark stencil marks on the opening's far wall, left of centre
the roof lining round the opening: a light grey-green matt paint, uneven and grimy, greyer in the folds
details.note: the same at the right, 0.84-1.0; the model's roof here is flat and near black

details.what: the lining's soft lumpy relief: irregular dents, folds and blisters as in a padded or sprayed insulating lining
a straight transverse crease across the lining left of the opening (a joint or a frame under it), continuing right of the flags at y 0.075
a small domed stud on the lining near the crease
the roof's front band: a flat light panel between the coaming's shadow and the header, meeting the header's narrow face in a dark crease along the loom's top; the type plate sits on it
details.size_cue: the band about twice the type plate's height deep
details.note: the model's roof runs flat and dark straight onto a thin slab at the header

details.what: the type plate: a black plate with a light rim, the vehicle's type in light characters on its left field, a blank light field at its right, a screw at the right end
details.size_cue: about a third of a visor's width long

details.what: an olive-brown rectangular box lying diagonally on the roof left of the opening, its lid stepped (a raised strip along its far edge, the step running the box's length), its face to the camera in shadow
details.size_cue: about one and a half type plates long

details.what: two short lines of white stencilled characters on the box's lid
a white-painted screw head on the lid's raised strip
a rusty bent strap bracket at the box's left end, its foot on the roof
a round black connector with a knurled ring in the box's left end
two cable plugs in the box's right end, their white, blue and red-tagged leads bending down to the header loom
a flat orange-brown strap or cable in the shadow at the coaming's left foot, ending in a red and a blue terminal by the box's plugs (an earthing braid?)
white plastic stand-off pegs on the roof, a wire wound round some, orange-brown caps on the two holding the right holder
a white moulded holder at the left end of the roof's front band: a lumpy rounded block on a peg with a brown cap
the same white holder at the right end, held on two capped pegs, a fold in its lower left
two rolled signal flags in olive cylindrical cases with domed ends, side by side with a dark gap between, running fore and aft on the roof at the right; an orange-brown strip along the upper one
details.size_cue: each about a forearm and a half long (the observation)

details.what: two white wrapped tubes side by side, running on from the flags toward the header, their lower ends rounded and closed; the flags' cases enter their upper ends through an orange-red ring
details.note: they look like the flags' holder tubes rather than a duct

details.what: a black stencilled part number along the upper white tube
a grey saddle plate under the tubes' lower ends, a bent wire pin with a brass tip beside it
a khaki canvas bag hung flat from under the flags' lower ends, down over the loom to the header, creased and folded at its foot
the windscreen header: a narrow face carrying the loom's clips, a deep shadowed recess behind the loom where the visors' brackets hang, a lower face, and a lip over the panes' top seals
details.size_cue: from the clips to the lip about three type plates' heights
details.note: the model has a flat grey wall from the roof down to the panes

details.what: a row of small round rivet or screw heads along the header's lower face, rust streaked along them

pattern.note: seen from the left end to the left visor's bracket; the row may run on in the shadow

details.what: the header loom the cab's whole width: two thick white cables, a black braided cable and four or five blue cables twisted among them, sagging between clips, curving up to the roof at the right end with a black loop
details.size_cue: the bundle about a third of the type plate's length thick
details.note: the model has three thin black cables

details.what: saddle clips on stand-offs with brass screw heads fixing the loom to the header's face

pattern.note: more probably hidden under the loom at the left

details.note: the model's clips are plain steel blocks

details.what: white plastic cable ties round the bundle
in-line round connectors with knurled rings in the loom
single blue cables leaving the loom: one loops down round the pillar box, one runs along the header's lower lip, one crosses the recess over the left visor
thin leads hanging below the header: a red-tipped wire by the centre post, blue-sleeved loops right of the right visor, a grey wire bundle over the left visor
a round cable-entry flange with about six small screws on the header's left end, a blue cable entering it
details.size_cue: about the gauge's diameter

details.what: a small fitting with a black hose or cable hanging in a loop under the loom, just left of the left visor's ball pivot
details.note: may be the left wiper tap or only a cable loop

details.what: the left visor hanging nearly upright in front of the left pane's top: a pale pressed plate, rectangular with rounded lower corners
details.size_cue: lower corner radius about a sixth of the visor's height
details.note: the model's visors are flat square slabs tilted up toward the roof at 25 degrees

details.what: a rolled rim round each visor's edge (a darker raised outline)
a triangular cigarette-advertising sticker on the left visor (HB): a portrait, the red logo and a German slogan along its foot
the right visor, as the left, hanging in front of the right pane's top
a shield-shaped Rothmans sticker: blue with the white script name and a red band under it
the visors' hinge rods along their top edges, each ending in a grey ball pivot at both ends of its visor
details.size_cue: the balls about a third of the gauge's diameter
details.note: the model has two dark lugs per visor and no balls

details.what: dark flat mounting bars in the header's recess carrying the hinge rods, short studs hanging from them to the ball pivots
the right visor's end bracket with a wing bolt, its friction lock
the visors' paint: pale grey-white, scuffed, with thin dark scribbles and a grey smudge
details.note: the right visor alike

details.what: a blue lamp hung under the header right of centre, behind the loom: a blue glass dome in a dark bezel with dark guard bars across it, a braided lead
details.size_cue: about the gauge's size
details.note: the model's cab dome lamp is a plain dome in the roof's centre about 1.2 m aft; the blue lamp is on the rear bulkhead

details.what: a thick black rubber seal of rounded section round each pane, following its large-radius corners, the same width all round
details.size_cue: about a quarter of the centre post's width
details.note: the model has plain rounded frames

details.what: a light steel flange round each seal, the opening's turned edge, merging into the post and the header
the panes' outline: rounded rectangles, corner radius about a quarter of the pane's height, the corners by the post the deepest
details.note: the model's corners are rounded; check the radius at the re-render

details.what: the glass: dark, smeared and dusty, faint reflections, the wipers' traces
the wiper arms and blades outside the glass, parked at a slant across the panes' middle: one on the left pane, two on the right
details.size_cue: each arm about the visor's width long
details.note: the model puts two wiper spindle posts inside on the sill at the panes' lower edges; the photo's sill has none

details.what: the centre post: a narrow flat-faced pressed member flaring at top and foot into the panes' corner radii
details.size_cue: at its narrowest about the gauge's width
details.note: the model draws a flat wall between two separate frames

details.what: the post's two edge flanges, one each side, the face between them plain
details.note: the model's raised seam strip down the post's middle is not in the photo

details.what: a round bar clamped across the post's right flange high up, a bent foot at its left end; the loop handle hangs from it
a long hanging loop of steel rod, twisted at its top, from the cross bar down the right pane's inner edge
details.size_cue: about a third of the pane's height long
details.note: the model has a small ring low on the post

details.what: a thin cable down the post's left edge, in a blue sleeve at the top, grey below
details.note: the model's black cable runs right of the post's middle

details.what: a hinged clamp at the post's foot: a crumpled folded bracket with a pin, on a raised boss where the post meets the sill
details.note: the model has a dark box, a steel bar and a ring there

details.what: the sill under the panes: a flat light ledge under the lower seals, a groove along its front, then a step down to the panels' faces
details.size_cue: the ledge about the gauge's diameter deep
details.note: the model has flat plates

details.what: a small strap bracket with a wing nut on the ledge, right of centre
a grey square box at the right pane's lower corner with a round domed cap on its face
a cast grey junction box with rounded corners at the top of the left pillar
details.size_cue: about twice the gauge's size

details.what: the box's glands: brass hex glands at its top and right, a white cap at its foot
a stencilled letter and marks on the box's face
one thick black cable from the box's right gland hanging down the pillar to below the frame, in front of the ring bracket
details.size_cue: about twice the header loom's white cable
details.note: the model has two thin black cables with steel tabs

details.what: blue cables looping down the far left edge round the junction box
two black instruction plates on the pillar, fine white text, two screws each
a large grey ring bracket of flat bar standing out from the pillar, the black cable passing in front of it
the left pillar's lower face: a grey plate angled toward the driver, a bolt at its top, its lower edge turned out as a lip
a black plate with text low on the pillar
details.note: which of the pillar's plates this is (clutch or diagram) is not read

details.what: the steering wheel: a thick black rim of round section, round spokes to the upper left and to the right (a third below the frame)
the wheel's large round hub with a ribbed horn cap and an emblem
details.size_cue: about a fifth of the wheel's diameter

details.what: the driver's white instrument plate, its top right corner chamfered: a speedometer (white dial, black figures, a coloured band) and a small black plate with a toggle and a lamp
details.note: the model's gauges are black on a grey plate

details.what: a black instruction plate headed for the driver, small text under it, left of the driver's plate
round screw heads on the dash's grey faces
the centre white panel: four round gauges with white dials in thin black bezels, a small black label plate, two round lamps or buttons
small vertical tubular U-handles on the dash's panels, the last left of the DP-3B
a black switch plate with a row of about ten toggles in round bezels, a legend strip under them
details.note: the model draws a 2 x 12 matrix of dark windows here; the observation names this plate.lowering_board

details.what: the toggles' white legends (ВКЛ over each) and the printed strip under the row
the DP-3B: a grey case with a meter window, a big round knob, a green and a red lamp and a black pointer knob below
details.note: the model has a grey bezel with a gauge and a knob

details.what: a white plate on the DP-3B's top with a black clamp bar and a threaded stud up to the frame
a grey upright bracket plate and a black bar right of the DP-3B, cables and a blue connector under them
a black plate with print in a grey rod frame, set at a slant at the dash's right end
a small lever with a ball end by the slanted plate
the dash's instrument panels painted white-ivory, the surrounds light grey
a dark panel low at the left with two round grey knobs
details.note: PU-303's top edge or the driver's switch panel

details.what: a small round pressure gauge at the upper right: a chrome bezel, a short case, a black dial with a white scale, on a brass tee; a grey plate behind it with a thin rod
details.size_cue: about half the type plate's length across

details.what: a thin pipe from the gauge's tee down the right pillar: a hex fitting, a union nut, an orange sleeve, then grey again
a white P-clip holding the pipe to the pillar
the right pillar's face: a light grey plate standing beside the right pane, its lower part sloping out with a chamfer crease running down and to the right
a bolt with a small bracket high on the right pillar
the front structure's paint (header, post, sill, pillars): a light grey-green with grime, rust streaks at the rivets, clips and the post's foot
details.note: the model's front wall is a flat mid grey
